learner_operation: Identify every true triangularity statement by inspecting the correct off-diagonal half of a square matrix, transposing and, for the hard family, adding or subtracting the transpose.

fixed_features.feature: Square 3x3 or 4x4 matrices and all-zero strict triangular regions
fixed_features.justification: Source tutorial defines upper/lower triangular only for square matrices and checks strict halves; sizes match observed workload.

fixed_features.feature: Moderate transpose-only and hard transpose sums/differences; Boolean select-all response
fixed_features.justification: These operations and response fields occur in the supplied practice questions; no new prerequisite is needed.

answer_roles.role: Which of direct upper, direct lower, and transpose-derived statements qualify
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary strict-half support including diagonal, upper-only, lower-only, and neither, then compute all keys and explanations. Labels and dimensions must not determine the subset.
answer_roles.observed: Overall patterns vary across templates, but each visible label/dimension/bank signature predicts a fixed whole subset; 25/25 delivered controls and 5/5 delivered batch bypass entries.

answer_roles.role: Derived sum/difference cancellation and None qualifier
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Mirrored entries can cancel or not within observed +/- workload; None should qualify if all ordinary statements are false.
answer_roles.observed: Hard both-sided samples force antisymmetric off-diagonal entries; normal generation rejects empty ordinary selections before explicit None is attached. None is false in 50/50 sampled questions.

coverage.case: Moderate lower, upper and diagonal global profiles
coverage.result: 25 questions across five moderate templates; globally varied answers, but no conditional variation within visible signatures. No neither-profile moderate source variant can pass the truth guard.
5/5 survive actual filtering and 5/5 whole responses are predicted by label/dimension/bank; this exact batch fails independently of larger controls.
25 hard samples included in 50 exact mathematical checks; two additional supplied source templates are unsupported.
